import sys, copy, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, para, algo, topo


def find_case(seed=5):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    for it in range(500):
        K = rng.randint(1, 4)
        prof = gen.gen_profile(rng, K, consistent=(rng.random() < 0.9))
        cal = para.Calibration(prof)
        if not cal.feasible:
            continue
        fab = gen.gen_fabric(rng, K=K)
        plan = algo.compile_plan(prof, fab)
        if plan.get('guard_ns') is not None:
            return prof, fab, plan
    return None


import random

def run():
    prof, fab, plan = find_case()
    print('case found, guard =', plan['guard_ns'])
    base = algo.audit(prof, fab, plan)
    print('base audit:', base)
    assert base == {'valid': True}
    P = plan['period_rounds']; N = fab['n']
    def mutate(name, fn, expect=True):
        p = copy.deepcopy(plan)
        fn(p)
        r = algo.audit(prof, fab, p)
        ok = (r == {'valid': True}) == expect
        print(('OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), name, r)
        return ok
    good = True
    good &= mutate('bounds+1', lambda p: p['bounds_as'][0].__setitem__(0, p['bounds_as'][0][0] + 1), False)
    good &= mutate('ages+1', lambda p: p['age_rounds'][0].__setitem__(0, p['age_rounds'][0][0] + 1), False)
    good &= mutate('peak+1', lambda p: p['peaks_as'].__setitem__(0, p['peaks_as'][0] + 1), False)
    good &= mutate('guard wrong', lambda p: p.__setitem__('guard_ns', 999999), False)
    good &= mutate('warmup+1', lambda p: p.__setitem__('warmup_cycle', (p['warmup_cycle'] or 0) + 1), False)
    good &= mutate('period wrong', lambda p: p.__setitem__('period_rounds', P + 1), False)
    def nullmat(p):
        p['bounds_as'] = None; p['age_rounds'] = None; p['pred'] = None; p['warmup_cycle'] = None
    good &= mutate('null matrices', nullmat, False)
    def badpred(p):
        for row in p['pred']:
            for i, c in enumerate(row):
                if c is not None:
                    row[i] = [c[0], c[1] + 1000]
                    return
    good &= mutate('bad pred kind', badpred, False)
    def badprof(p):
        p['profile']['upper_ps'][0][0] = 12345
    good &= mutate('bad profile', badprof, False)
    good &= mutate('status inconsistent', lambda p: p.__setitem__('status', 'inconsistent'), False)
    # inconsistent profile handling
    rng = random.Random(99)
    inc = None
    for it in range(200):
        K = rng.randint(2, 3)
        p2 = gen.gen_profile(rng, K, consistent=False)
        c2 = para.Calibration(p2)
        if not c2.feasible:
            inc = p2; break
    if inc:
        print('inconsistent profile found')
        art = algo.compile_plan(inc, fab)
        print('plan for inconsistent:', art)
        r = algo.audit(inc, fab, art)
        print('OK  ' if r == {'valid': True} else 'FAIL', 'inconsistent plan', r)
        good &= (r == {'valid': True})
        bad = dict(art); bad['cycle'] = []
        r = algo.audit(inc, fab, bad)
        print('OK  ' if r == {'valid': False} else 'FAIL', 'empty cycle', r)
        good &= (r == {'valid': False})
        bad = dict(art); bad['cycle'] = [999999]
        r = algo.audit(inc, fab, bad)
        print('OK  ' if r == {'valid': False} else 'FAIL', 'out of range cycle', r)
        good &= (r == {'valid': False})
        # consistent profile claiming inconsistency
        r = algo.audit(prof, fab, {'status': 'inconsistent', 'cycle': art['cycle']})
        print('OK  ' if r == {'valid': False} else 'FAIL', 'false inconsistency', r)
        good &= (r == {'valid': False})
    print('ALL OK' if good else 'SOME FAILURES')

run()
